subject: SummitGlade onboarding: privacy kit, DPA e-sign, and PO routing
messages:
From: Aisha Khan <aisha@summitglade.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SummitGlade onboarding: next steps for DPA + PO

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the warm intro yesterday. We're excited to get production traffic over the finish line. Procurement asked me to confirm Redwood's required deliverables so we can hand off to our finance and security teams. Our initial asks:

- A copy of the DPA you expect us to sign (we can e-sign).
- A link to your current SOC 2 Type II report or an access path (read-only preferred).
- Your most recent subprocessor inventory (CSV or DOCX).
- PO and invoice routing instructions (who to send PO to, billing email, net terms).

I'm attaching a short vendor intake form we use internally; happy to fill details once we know the required DPA version and where to e-sign.

Attachments: vendor-intake-form.docx (stub)

Quick background: SummitGlade will be using the Redwood Hosted API for production inference (US region), starting with a pilot 500k tokens/month and ramp plan. Let me know if you need a copy of our security questionnaire.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships
SummitGlade, Inc.
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha@summitglade.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitGlade onboarding: next steps for DPA + PO

Hi Aisha — great to meet you virtually.

Short answer: we can walk SummitGlade through a standard procurement onboarding that includes a DPA e-sign, SOC 2 access, and our subprocessor inventory. Below are the specific items and the quickest path forward:

1) DPA: we use a standard Redwood DPA v1.2 for Hosted customers. I'll attach the PDF here and will send a DocuSign link for the executive signature once you confirm the signatory.

2) SOC 2: we host the current Type II report behind an authenticated read-only link. For external vendors we provide a time-limited URL after an NDA or by direct upload to your S3. If you prefer, I can share a secure view link (expires 14 days).

3) Subprocessors: attached is our canonical subprocessor inventory (CSV) and a short table of changes in the last 12 months.

4) PO / Billing: Finance prefers a PO to be routed to billing@redwood.ai with the following fields: SummitGlade legal name, remit-to address, Redwood quote ID (if provided), and net30 terms by default. If you need net45, please indicate and I'll route to Finance. Lauren (cc'd) will create the initial purchase record and can confirm the billing email for AP.

Action items for SummitGlade:
- Confirm DPA signatory name and email (so we send DocuSign).
- Confirm whether you want SOC 2 link or S3 transfer.
- Return the completed vendor intake form if you have legal entity and remit details.

Attachments: SummitGlade_DPA_v1.2.pdf (stub), subprocessor_inventory_Q3-2026.csv (stub)

Thanks — I'll put Lauren on the loop to help with PO setup.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai

From: Aisha Khan <aisha@summitglade.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure+invoice@summitglade.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitGlade onboarding: next steps for DPA + PO

Hi Neha — thanks, that's super-clear. Quick clarifications from our side:

- Signatory: our CFO, Priya Menon (priya.m@summitglade.com) will sign the DPA. Please send the DocuSign to her.
- SOC 2: we'd prefer the secure view link (14-day expiry) so our security team can review without S3 transfer.
- Subprocessors: CSV looks good at a glance — is there a short column mapping of data access purpose? If not, can you confirm whether the listed subprocessors have access to customer prompt data or only telemetry/metrics?
- PO: we'll issue a PO to billing@redwood.ai. Our AP team needs the Redwood remit address and Redwood tax ID on the invoice. Also want to confirm net30 is acceptable.

Also — we're running a small pilot in us-west1 region; can you confirm data residency statements (if any) tied to the Hosted API? Security will want the exact text we can copy into our vendor register.

Thanks,
Aisha

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha@summitglade.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SummitGlade onboarding: next steps for DPA + PO

Thanks, Aisha — answers below and next steps.

- DocuSign: sent to Priya Menon (priya.m@summitglade.com) at 14:00 PT. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/summitglade/redwood-dpa. Please confirm when signed and we'll finalize the account.

- SOC 2: shared secure view link: https://summitglade.s3.amazonaws.com/reports/SOC2-TypeII-2026.html (read-only, expires 14 days). Note: link requires token; we sent the token in a separate secure email to your security lead.

- Subprocessors & access: short answer — subprocessors listed are categorized in the CSV under the column "access_scope". For clarity: none of our listed subprocessors have access to raw customer prompt content by default. Access is limited to telemetry, logging, and model hosting infra; any exception for debugging requires explicit customer consent and is logged. I've pasted a short data residency blurb below for your register.

Data residency statement (copyable): "Redwood Hosted API routes and stores inference logs and KV cache in the configured region (e.g., us-west1) by default. Customers may opt for private deployment or dedicated capacity for guaranteed tenancy. Customer prompt content is retained according to contract terms; see DPA section 3.1 for retention specifics."

- PO / Billing details: billing@redwood.ai is our AP intake. Remit-to: Redwood Inference, 1201 Market St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94103. Tax ID: 94-2123345. Net terms: net30 accepted. If you need a specific purchase order template, I've attached Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (stub).

Attachments: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx (stub)

Next steps:
1) Priya signs DPA in DocuSign.
2) Your security lead reviews SOC 2 link (tokened).
3) Procure issues PO to billing@redwood.ai with remit/tax details.
4) Once DPA is signed and PO accepted, we flip the account to production and confirm quota.

Looping in Ben (sales) for quota and onboarding timeline.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Vendor Ops
Redwood Inference
